Asset type: SOL RADAR website Open Graph social link preview for KakaoTalk. Create one finished wide 1200 x 630 pixel image (aspect ratio 1.905:1).
Primary request: A refined Korean B2B software brand cover for an AI public procurement bid decision-support platform, matching its restrained existing website.
Input image: reference image of the EXISTING red S/radar brand symbol. Preserve the recognizable symbol and red coloration; use it modestly next to the SOL RADAR wordmark, do not invent a new logo.
Style: immaculate flat editorial typography on pure white, dark navy charcoal #191F28 headings, blue #1B64DA used sparingly, faint #E5E8EB dividers. Korean sans-serif similar to Pretendard. High legibility, premium understated enterprise SaaS.
Composition: generous white space, all essential content safely inset at least 75px. Top left a small existing red brand symbol with bold dark navy wordmark "SOL RADAR". Main headline occupies left 65% in large bold Korean type on two lines, exactly "입찰의 기회를 찾고," then "판단의 근거를 잇다". Below it smaller calm gray subtitle exactly "공공 SI·AX 기업을 위한 AI 입찰 의사결정 지원". Lower left a thin divider and three modest labels exactly "공고 탐색" then "자격 검토" then "근거 기반 판단", separated by small blue dots.
Right side: one restrained abstract blue radar motif rendered as thin concentric blue line arcs and a precise radial line, with three small document silhouettes aligned to the radar, communicating discovery and evidence. Keep it airy and elegant and secondary to the headline. This is brand artwork, not a screenshot.
Constraints: accurate Korean lettering, clean wordmark, no fake statistics, no scores, no probabilities, no invented customer names, no government logos, no buttons, no browser frame, no photos, no 3D, no heavy shadows, no gradients, no watermark. Opaque white background.
